content.text:
충분한 정보를 수집했습니다. 전체 탐색 결과를 정리합니다.

---

## FreeLang v4 라이브러리 탐색 결과

### 디렉토리 구조

#### freelang-v4-stdlib/
```
CLAUDE.md  README.md  package.json  tsconfig.json
src/
  index.ts          ← 통합 export (45개 함수)
  types.ts          ← 공통 Value 타입
  string-functions.ts
  functional.ts
  json-functions.ts
  regex.ts
  database.ts
tests/
  stdlib.test.ts    ← 56개 테스트 (5 그룹)
```

#### freelang-v4-concurrency/
```
CLAUDE.md  README.md  API_REFERENCE.md  BEST_PRACTICES.md
CHANGELOG.md  UPDATE_WORKFLOW.md  VERSION_POLICY.md
package.json  tsconfig.json  jest.config.js  fl-lock.gogs
src/
  index.ts
  types.ts
  actors/spawn.ts
  channels/channel.ts
  reactors/select.ts
  synchronizers/wait.ts
  synchronizers/sleep.ts
dist/              ← 컴파일된 출력
tests/
  concurrency.test.ts   ← 80+ 테스트
```

---

### 공통 Value 타입 시스템

모든 함수는 `Value` tagged union 타입 기반으로 동작합니다.

```typescript
// /dev/archived/freelang-v4-stdlib/src/types.ts
type Value =
  | { tag: "i32";    val: number }
  | { tag: "f64";    val: number }
  | { tag: "str";    val: string }
  | { tag: "bool";   val: boolean }
  | { tag: "arr";    elements: Value[] }
  | { tag: "struct"; fields: Map<string, Value> }
  | { tag: "ok";     val: Value }
  | { tag: "err";    val: string }
  | { tag: "some";   val: Value }
  | { tag: "none" }
  | { tag: "void" };
```

생성 헬퍼: `V.i32(n)`, `V.str(s)`, `V.bool(b)`, `V.arr([])`, `V.ok(v)`, `V.err("msg")`, `V.some(v)`, `V.none()`, `V.struct({...})`

---

### 주요 함수 시그니처

#### JSON 관련 (`src/json-functions.ts`)

```typescript
json_parse(s: Value): Value             // ok(Value) | err(msg)
json_stringify(v: Value): Value         // str | err
json_validate(s: Value, schema: Value): Value  // bool
json_pretty(v: Value): Value            // str (들여쓰기 2칸)
json_get(v: Value, path: Value): Value  // some(Value) | none  (점 경로: "a.b.c")
json_merge(a: Value, b: Value): Value   // ok(Value) | err
```

#### String 관련 (`src/string-functions.ts`)

```typescript
str_len(s: Value): Value                       // i32
str_upper(s: Value): Value                     // str
str_lower(s: Value): Value                     // str
str_trim(s: Value): Value                      // str
str_split(s: Value, sep: Value): Value         // arr[str]
str_join(arr: Value, sep: Value): Value        // str
str_contains(s: Value, sub: Value): Value      // bool
str_starts_with(s: Value, pre: Value): Value   // bool
str_ends_with(s: Value, suf: Value): Value     // bool
str_replace(s: Value, from: Value, to: Value): Value      // str (첫 번째)
str_replace_all(s: Value, f: Value, t: Value): Value      // str
str_slice(s: Value, start: Value, end: Value): Value      // str
str_repeat(s: Value, n: Value): Value          // str
str_index_of(s: Value, sub: Value): Value      // i32 (-1 = 없음)
str_pad_start / str_pad_end / str_char_at / str_to_chars
```

#### Functional (`src/functional.ts`)

```typescript
type FlFn = (...args: Value[]) => Value

compose(...fns: FlFn[]): FlFn      // 우→좌 합성: compose(f, g)(x) = f(g(x))
pipe(...fns: FlFn[]): FlFn         // 좌→우 합성: pipe(f, g)(x) = g(f(x))
curry(fn: FlFn, arity?: number): FlFn
memoize(fn: FlFn): FlFn
memoize_tracked(fn: FlFn): FlFn
partial(fn: FlFn, ...args: Value[]): FlFn
once(fn: FlFn): FlFn
flip(fn: FlFn): FlFn
identity(v: Value): Value
constant(v: Value): () => Value
```

---

### Concurrency 함수 시그니처

#### spawn() — Actor 생성 (`src/actors/spawn.ts`)

```typescript
// 단일 Actor 생성
async function spawn<T>(
  fn: (...args: any[]) => Promise<T> | T,
  ...args: any[]
): Promise<Actor<T>>

// 복수 생성
async function spawnMany<T>(
  tasks: Array<() => Promise<T> | T>
): Promise<Actor<T>[]>

// 보조 함수
function waitForActor<T>(actor: Actor<T>): Promise<T>
function isActorRunning<T>(actor: Actor<T>): boolean
```

> mutex()는 이 라이브러리에 없음. 대신 채널 메시지 패싱으로 공유 상태를 대체하는 철학 ("메모리를 공유해서 통신하지 말고, 통신해서 메모리를 공유하라").

#### channel() / chan() — 채널 생성 (`src/channels/channel.ts`)

```typescript
// 채널 생성 (mutex 대체)
function chan<T = any>(name?: string, bufferSize?: number): Channel<T>
// bufferSize 기본값: 100

interface Channel<T> {
  send(msg: T, sender?: string): Promise<void>
  recv(): Promise<Message<T>>
  close(): void
  isClosed(): boolean
  buffer(): Message<T>[]
}

// 채널 쌍 생성 (send/recv 분리)
function chanPair<T>(name?: string, bufferSize?: number): [Channel<T>, Channel<T>]
function isChannelOpen<T>(ch: Channel<T>): boolean
function getChannelBufferSize<T>(ch: Channel<T>): number
```

#### select() — 다중 채널 대기 (`src/reactors/select.ts`)

```typescript
async function select<T = any>(
  cases: SelectCase<T>[],
  defaultTimeout?: number
): Promise<void>

interface SelectCase<T> {
  channel: Channel<T>;
  handler: (msg: Message<T>) => Promise<void> | void;
  timeout?: number;
}

function selectWithDefault<T>(cases: SelectCase<T>[], defaultFn: () => void): Promise<void>
function selectLoop<T>(cases: SelectCase<T>[], condition: () => boolean): Promise<void>
class SelectGroup<T> { ... }
```

#### wait() — 동기화 (`src/synchronizers/wait.ts`)

```typescript
async function wait<T>(actors: Actor<T>[]): Promise<WaitResult<T>>
async function waitWithTimeout<T>(actors: Actor<T>[], timeoutMs: number): Promise<WaitResult<T>>
async function waitAll<T>(actors: Actor<T>[]): Promise<T[]>        // 실패 시 throw
async function waitFirst<T>(actors: Actor<T>[]): Promise<T>
async function waitN<T>(actors: Actor<T>[], n: number): Promise<T[]>

class WaitGroup<T> {
  add(actor: Actor<T>): void
  addMany(actors: Actor<T>[]): void
  async wait(): Promise<WaitResult<T>>
  async waitWithTimeout(timeoutMs: number): Promise<WaitResult<T>>
  count(): number
  reset(): void
}

interface WaitResult<T> {
  completed: T[];
  failed: Error[];
  cancelled: string[];
  timeout: boolean;
}
```

### import/use 패턴

테스트 파일 기준 실제 사용 패턴:

```typescript
// stdlib 전체 import
import {
  str_len, str_upper, json_parse, json_stringify,
  compose, pipe, curry, memoize,
  db_create, db_query, db_insert,
  V, Value
} from "../src/index";

// concurrency import
import {
  spawn, spawnMany, waitForActor,
  chan, chanPair,
  select, wait, waitAll, waitFirst,
  sleep, yieldControl, retryWithBackoff,
  WaitGroup, ActorState
} from '../src/index';
```

사용 예시:

```typescript
// JSON
const result = json_parse(V.str('{"name": "alice"}'));
// result.tag === "ok"

// spawn + chan
const ch = chan<number>("worker-results");
const actor = await spawn(async () => {
  await ch.send(42);
});
const msg = await ch.recv();   // msg.data === 42
const result = await waitForActor(actor);

// select
await select([
  { channel: ch1, handler: (msg) => console.log('ch1:', msg.data) },
  { channel: ch2, handler: (msg) => console.log('ch2:', msg.data), timeout: 5000 }
]);
```

| 항목 | 내용 |

| mutex 대체 | `chan()` 채널로 공유 상태 접근 직렬화 |
| 외부 의존성 | 없음 (자체 Value 구조 정의) |
